name: Woven Throw Blanket
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality polyester for a soft, durable, and comfortable feel.
    - Features a woven-style surface that gives the blanket a textured and decorative appearance.
    - Finished with elegant fringed edges for a classic and stylish touch.
    - Fringe length is approx. 2.5 cm.
    - Designed for both everyday comfort and decorative use.
    - Lightweight yet cozy enough for use in all seasons.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 3 sizes:
             +) S: 130 x 90 cm ~ 51.18 x 35.43 in
             +) M: 160 x 130 cm ~ 62.99 x 51.18 in
             +) L: 220 x 160 cm ~ 86.61 x 62.99 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - One-sided printing with vibrant colors and sharp image details.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed for both comfort and home decoration.
    - Can be used as a cozy throw blanket for sofas, couches, beds, and reading chairs.
    - Suitable for relaxing, napping, lounging, or staying warm indoors.
    - Works beautifully as a decorative accent for living rooms, bedrooms, guest rooms, and dorm spaces.
    - Can be draped over a couch, folded at the end of a bed, or displayed on a chair for added texture and style.
    - Great for seasonal décor, holiday decoration, and themed room styling.
    - Suitable for everyday use while also serving as a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Easy to match with other home décor items such as pillows, bedding, and seasonal accents.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for family members, friends, couples, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for housewarming gifts, birthdays, anniversaries, and holiday celebrations.
    - Great for Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day and other seasonal occasions.
    - Ideal for personalized gifting with names, quotes, photos, or themed artwork.
    - A cozy and meaningful gift for anyone who enjoys soft blankets and decorative home accessories.
    - Suitable for both practical use and sentimental keepsake gifting.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Woven Throw Blanket

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
